headline: Surprise on Mazut: This Is What Fuel Prices Will Look Like Today
summary: A new fuel price schedule was expected in Lebanon, amid rising public anger over recent increases and their knock-on effect on food and other prices. Fuel station owners' union head George Barakes commented on the outlook.
why: Fuel prices feed into transport and food costs, so changes in Lebanon's fuel schedule affect inflation and household budgets.
